name: Empurrada de trenó
movement: Sled push; lean into high handles and drive sled forward with short powerful steps, maintain neutral trunk.
cue: Incline-se nas alças do trenó e empurre com passos curtos e firmes, mantendo o tronco alinhado.
priority: lista de 500 exercícios; variação complementar após os bases/principais
illustration: Original sprite sheet converted to a six-frame looping GIF
